correctness.rationale: Any distinct edges within the same V_i−V_j cut conflict iff they are disjoint (complement of the line graph of K_ni,nj). Any edges from different cuts conflict, yielding conflict graph join over all i<j. Each cut factor has chromatic number min(n_i,n_j), attained uniquely by stars on its strictly smaller shore, with two alternative shores iff equal sizes at least 2. Thus χinj=sum min(n_i,n_j); all unlabeled optimal color partitions number 2^t and labeled k-colorings 2^t k!. Direct small graph edge-pair conflict testing corroborates but the argument proves all part sizes.
